summary.zh: 用可复现的流程定位 bug 根因
summary.en: Trace bugs to their root cause

description.zh:
遇到 bug、测试失败或意外行为时，先建立可复现证据，再沿调用链追到根因。
强调先改测试复现、再做最小修复，避免拍脑袋改代码。
description.en:
When a bug, failing test, or unexpected behavior shows up, reproduce it first, then trace the call chain to the root cause.
Emphasizes a failing test followed by the smallest fix instead of guessing.
